Last season I did not put much chemical fertilizer on this small bean plot, and I will keep it that way again. This land is mine, so I will carry manure to it, but because the plot is only 0.25 hectare I will not spend scarce cash on a fertilizer bag for beans when I need money for my other fields. I have seen improved bean seed do better in nearby farms, so I will plant that, spray if insects trouble the crop, and depend on the rains.
